data.title: imas-ambix plan-refactor
data.summary: Bring all imas-ambix per-plan JSON files into conformance with the reckon redesign schema.

sections.body: The reckon redesign landed on 2026-05-26. All per-plan JSON files carry legacy fields from pre-redesign tooling that must be stripped: decisions_def, followups_done, dec_open, last, created.
(See HTML for the file-by-file table.) 14 per-plan files need legacy field strip; 2 phase-record stubs need title/summary/status added; index.json dashboard format is intentionally retained.
Strip decisions_def, followups_done, dec_open, last, created from data. Keep slug, phase, owner, blockers, comments, last_modified, _version, isHeroPlan (referenced by SPA).
redesign-rollout and tokenizers-12-landed are phase-record artifacts; add minimal title/summary/status: 'shipped' only.
Every per-plan JSON parses to schema-conformant shape; SPA renders all plans without error; legacy fields removed; temporary audit markdown deleted.
